<includeonly>{{#if:{{{2|{{{episode|}}}}}}
  | {{Resistance episode/episode|{{{1|{{{season|}}}}}}|{{{2|{{{episode|}}}}}}|{{{noquotes|}}}}}
  | {{#switch: {{{1|{{{season|}}}}}}
    | 1 | shorts = [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]] (and its accompanying shorts)
    | 2 = [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two]]}}
    | #default = {{#ifeq:{{NAMESPACENUMBER}}|0|[[Category:Invalid Film parameter arguments]]|}}
}}</includeonly><noinclude>
{{Resistance episode|1|1}}

==Usage==
<pre><nowiki>{{Resistance episode|season|episode}}</nowiki></pre>, where {{Para|season}} is 1, 2, or "shorts" (without quotes), and {{Para|episode}} is an optional episode number.

This is used by {{Tl|ResistanceDate}} and not superfluous!
